script: Let's compare soccer slash football legends to NBA legends. Pelé is like the Michael Jordan of soccer. He was the original GOAT of his generation, putting soccer on the map, and is regarded as the GOAT by people who watched both generations. Lionel Messi is like the LeBron James of football. He's considered the modern GOAT of his generation and has both longevity and a plethora of skills, like how LeBron can play all five positions. They also have a ton of records. Cristiano Ronaldo is like the Kobe Bryant of soccer. The greatest pure scorer/striker and the hardest worker. Messi was genetically gifted for soccer, but like Kobe, Ronaldo just made up for it with his intense work ethic. Neymar is like the Kyrie Irving of the sport. They both had opportunities to play with their generations' GOAT, Neymar and Messi versus LeBron and Kyrie, but on their own they never got to reach their full potential due to injuries. Erling Haaland is like peak Giannis Antetokounmpo. Both are modern freaks of nature, they overpower their opponents with size, speed, and raw dominance. Mohamed Salah is like Steph Curry of soccer. His cut and shift is very similar to Curry's offensive gravity pull on defense, which revolutionized the game. Lamine Yamal is the Wemby of football. At just 18 years old, he became Spain's youngest player to score a goal in the FIFA World Cup and has the potential to become the next face of the sport.
